family_reports.body: Destroyed my relationship with my granddaughter.
The system has broke my family down to the point that it is past the point of being repaired. They have destroyed everything we’ve worked for and I will never get that back.

I spent years trying to protect my family, only to watch prolonged litigation drain our finances, destroy our stability, and leave us homeless. My daughter has special needs, and the system that should have helped us instead made it harder to keep her safe, housed, and connected to the services she needs.
My children send me videos daily crying. They think they don’t get to ever come home.
TORE UP OUR HAPPY HOME AN DESTROYED MY TWINS EMOTIONALLY AND MENTALLY
Tore my family apart. I haven't talked to my son in months
